snippet.title: Sushi Cat - Tower Defense (Meow Available)
snippet.description:
The wait is over... Sushi Cat - Tower Defense is officially OUT MEOW! 

Steam : https://armor.ag/SC-TD
Switch : https://armor.ag/SCTD-Switch

The wicked sorcerer cook Broccolinni has corrupted the sushi hordes, and it's up to you to stop them! Deploy cat-themed towers, build winding mazes, and place traps to defend Sushi Cat. Feed him enormous amounts of sushi, unlock powerful upgrades, and survive the roguelite chaos!

Features:
Deploy a variety of cat-themed towers & traps
Block routes and build custom mazes
Unlock permanent upgrades & powerful abilities

#SushiCat #TowerDefense #ArmorGamesStudios
